clips.title: The story
paras: Deep in the gloomy wilderness of Duskwood, the eccentric hermit Abercrombie claims his isolated shack is under siege by the walking dead. To protect his home, he tasks passing adventurers with harvesting ghoul ribs to assemble a bizarre protective scarecrow.

Abercrombie lives far beyond the guarded boundaries of Darkshire, isolated amidst the shadowed trees of Duskwood. Out here, wandering ghouls like Flesh Eaters and Bone Chewers roam unchecked. Claiming that ravenous corpses recently battered down his walls, the panicked hermit requests the ribs of these horrors to fashion a deterrent, hoping a grisly effigy will keep the hungry dead at bay.

While common sense might suggest running toward the safety of the Night Watch or fortifying his wooden shack, Abercrombie insists on macabre methods. He believes erecting an effigy made from ghoul remains will frighten off other scavenging dead. Though building a scarecrow out of slaughtered undead seems unsettling, travelers in Duskwood often take the eccentric hermit at his word to earn some needed coin.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I live so far from the protection of town, it's a wonder the ghouls and the walking dead haven't eaten me! In fact, just yesterday a pack of Bone Chewers was pounding on the walls of my house!
I want to make an effigy - a kind of "scarecrow" for Ghouls. To do that I need some Ghoul Ribs. You can get them from Flesh Eaters, Bone Chewers, Brain Eaters, Rotted Ones and Plague Spreaders.
Get the ribs for me, and I will repay you with some coin.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I think I hear a pack of Ghouls scurrying around the back of the house - I better put that effigy up quick! Did you get those Ghoul Ribs for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, thanks. These will do just the trick!
